title: Tailscale attestor cannot parse a chunked LocalAPI response
description:
The Tailscale attestor cannot read a live tailscaled. Observed by running personad on the developer box with Tailscale up:

  WARN persona_grpc::service: attestor enumerate failed name="tailscale"
       err=source unavailable: trailing characters at line 1 column 2

CAUSE. persona-attestors/src/tailscale.rs fetch_status() finds the end of the HTTP headers, then hands everything after it to serde_json. tailscaled answers with Transfer-Encoding: chunked, so the bytes after the header block are not JSON, they are a chunked body:

  Transfer-Encoding: chunked
  <blank>
  6cfb
  {...

serde_json reads "6" as a number, meets "c", and reports trailing characters at column 2. Verified against the real socket with nc: tailscaled 1.102.2 sends Content-Type: application/json and Transfer-Encoding: chunked together, and does so even though the request sets Connection: close.

WHY NO TEST CAUGHT IT. Nothing in the suite drives a live tailscaled, and the unit tests feed fetch_status a hand-written unchunked response. The bug lives in the gap between the fixture and the wire.

IMPACT TODAY. Tailscale is the only attestor on this machine that finds a source to talk to at all. It is also the only one that could return a Candidate without new code. So this single parse error is the difference between enumerate() finding one identity and finding none. It does not change whether a credential is issued, because no attestor implements prove().

FIX. Either decode the chunked body, which is about fifteen lines, or take the upgrade path already named in the file's ponytail comment: "upgrade to hyper with UDS connector when full LocalAPI coverage needed". The de-chunker is the smaller change and keeps hyper out of persona-attestors; the hyper route earns its keep only when more of the LocalAPI is needed. Whichever is chosen, a test must feed fetch_status a chunked body, since that is what the server actually sends.
close_reason: Fixed in the commit above: chunked body decoder plus the Self.UserID -> User[id].LoginName lookup. Tailscale now enumerates cleanly against a live tailscaled 1.102.2.
